title: Utility: Appendix E aggregator — scan shared/appxE_contribs and integrate new sets-only contributions
abstract: Scans storage/shared/appxE_contribs for JSON/CSV sets-only files (schema v1.0), validates, computes boundary/Top‑K Jaccards and Gate v1 (strict/inclusive) on Noesis geometry, writes per-file results JSON under storage/noesis/nmap/results/, and appends/updates entries in appendix_E_summary.json. Returns the baseline pack (with 1e−9 shrink).
